summer.vegetation: Make B the continuous overhanging bank body and U a low connected underlayer; retain P as a counter-accent rather than repeating three upright groups.
existing_controls: tree_final_scale.make_tree(form="B", architecture="terminal-droop") for one supported bank member
P/B/U posture, stem_ratio and vigor; keep U small/light
summer.rocks: Replace one upright jointed plinth with lower compact/rounded base_mass and partly buried layered bedrock; keep B-type supporting masses unequal.
summer.ground: Use a low shared bank and connected color support, retaining the diagonal passage rather than a separate pedestal below every tree.

autumn.vegetation: Break one B crown episode with dead-limb or damaged-crown; retain unequal P/B remnants and reduce the repeated center-relay silhouette.
existing_controls: accent="dead-limb" or "damaged-crown" on selected P/B/U members
Unequal vigor and stem_ratio; no new botanical family
autumn.rocks: Expose angular/layered ledges and fewer unequal blocks, rather than only enlarging the same jointed-parent/layered-front B recipe.
autumn.ground: Use broken bedding/contact cues and an asymmetric terrace; separate dry exposed ground from retreating canopy color.

winter.vegetation: Keep one P shelter and an incomplete B skeleton, using broken-top or suppressed accents selectively; make the small P8 remnant subordinate to its long rest.
existing_controls: accent="broken-top" or "suppressed" only on selected members
Retain pine foliage; do not make every tree uniformly bare
winter.rocks: Use one coherent A-style bedrock mass plus a few subordinate stones instead of three similar B plinth formations.
winter.ground: Expose a broad structural plane and isolated contacts. Preserve P8 terrain, skyline and gentle ending.

W_status: Experimental only; no promotion to default and no W generation in this Work
library_policy: Use accepted anatomy and bounded scene arrangements; do not introduce a new botanical or rock engine
